description: This file contains hook implementations for the Drupal file module, including functions to respond to file copy and move events, and documentation on file security and upload handling.

methods.name: hook_file_copy
methods.description: Handles the event when a file is copied, ensuring the filename starts with the owner's username and logs the action.

methods.name: hook_file_move
methods.description: Handles the event when a file is moved, ensuring the filename starts with the owner's username and logs the action.
